title: Luigi's company attacked, court demand for Lazar communications

tellings.quote: To to zero and we were attacked. Nobody knows this, but we were attacked ferociously for over a year and a half.

plain: A Montreal researcher named Luigi Vendittelli says that after he got involved with Bob Lazar, a man known for saying he worked on recovered alien craft, his company was "attacked ferociously for over a year and a half" until it went to zero, and that a court document demanded his communications with Lazar. "Nobody knows this," he tells Michels, presenting it as a price paid for standing near Lazar's story.
